purpose: Twelve separate development controls; scientific expectations require review. No runtime instructions or gold accuracy labels.

cases.expectation: A grouping-only causal property may classify broader but can never be exact or formally asserted.

cases.source: Process T increased the rate of Process Q.
cases.expectation: Read definition and comment separately; do not infer required execution from a rate increase.

cases.source: Resource-use efficiency was measured in Crop C.
cases.expectation: Test a supplied encompassing plant-trait definition before related or unresolved; never equate efficiency with uptake.

cases.source: Group A plants were selected for Trait Q.
cases.expectation: Group A remains the organism/population, not the selection trait; a shared parent does not imply identity.

cases.source: Trait Q, Trait R and Trait S were increased by Treatment T by 8%, 12% and 15%, respectively.
cases.expectation: Three independently asserted outcomes, correct passive roles and corresponding metrics.

cases.source: Treatment T increased Resource Q content in Organ A and Organ B.
cases.expectation: Two organ-qualified outcomes, complete literal coordination anchors and shared treatment.

cases.source: Group A allocated Compound Q to Organ O, thereby enhancing Trait R and facilitating increased Trait S.
cases.expectation: The allocation mechanism supplies downstream causal subjects; later result verbs are checked, not just the first.

cases.source: As Factor T increased, Trait Q declined.
cases.expectation: Trait Q declined, not Factor T; the trend alone does not assert causation.

cases.source: Trait Q was highest under treatment Code K compared with Code L.
cases.expectation: Trait Q remains the measured trait; codes are conditions/comparator, not quantities higher than a trait.

cases.source: Group A has the ability to allocate Compound Q to Organ O.
cases.expectation: Preserve ability, material endpoint and labelled destination; do not assert the event occurred.

cases.source: Treatment T increased Trait Q by 10%, but this increase was not statistically significant.
cases.expectation: Retain observed direction and non-significance; no unqualified asserted causal relation.

cases.source: Combined Treatment T and Treatment U changed the root-to-shoot ratio.
cases.expectation: Preserve the joint treatment and single ratio; do not invent independent treatment effects.
